raw_test_scope: Snapshot pool_layer separates ordinary_manual, special_manual, doorway_manual, ordinary_semi, special_semi; non_doorway alone does not mean ordinary.
same_count: Exact raw corner-pair count equality; still compares top/bottom azimuth and scale, not just corner number.
pairing: One-to-one Hungarian azimuth matching within 9 degrees; unmatched fraction reported separately.
aggregation: Equal class means within; equal unordered class-pair means across; then image and building means.
qualification: Historical labels fitted excluding target building; no target fusion score used for candidates.
full_combination_note: Capacity is a mathematical feasibility bound, not a claim that endpoints or permutations were computed.
history_scope_clarification: Frozen labels use non-doorway fixed-reference history with known easy/medium/hard grade; includes declared auxiliary special-range history e9zR4mvMWw7-16 and jtcxE69GiFV-18. No relabeling was performed.
